body.segment: An all organic, photopatterned 4 × 4 one diode-one resistor (1D–1R) cell array consisting of a photopatterned organic schottky diode and organic memory were fabricated and tested.
Our results show that the all-organic type photopatterned 4 × 4 1D–1R cell array architecture not only improves reading accessibility, but also prevents cross-talk with neighboring cells.
Each 1D–1R cell in the array architecture showed excellent switching performance, which suggests that such memory devices can be used for future advanced nonvolatile memory applications.
